items.description: Fixes the issue that installing `@williamthorsen/tank-redis` beside `@williamthorsen/tank` 0.2.0 or later reported an unmet peer dependency, because the peer range `^0.1.0` accepted only 0.1.x; the range is now `>=0.1.0 <1.0.0`. (#1004)

Adds `createRedisStore`, which returns a `@williamthorsen/tank` balance store that keeps each tank key as a Redis hash and runs its compare-and-set as an atomic Lua script through any client with an `eval(script, keys, args)` method, such as `@upstash/redis` directly or node-redis and ioredis through a one-line wrapper. (#1002)

Adds the `@williamthorsen/tank-redis` package with its manifest, TypeScript config, license, README, and an entry point that does not export anything yet, and registers it in the `scope:tank-redis` label definitions, the ESLint root-module allowlist, the README package table, and `AGENTS.md`. (#1001)
